answer: Sybil defense must make fake identities expensive, not just detectable. Each agent posts stake and does verifiable work, so a fable of clones costs real compute and capital per copy. Peers attest the work and lose reputation when they vouch falsely, so a echo of sock puppets pays the same per-unit price as honest agents while earning nothing. The sable is the margin: raise the cost of faking above the reward, and mass forgery stops paying.
